semiconductor_relevance: High — Samco Inc. specializes in manufacturing processing equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on thin film technologies.
summary: Samco Inc. is a leading manufacturer of thin film processing equipment for semiconductor and related industries, providing advanced solutions for R&D and production applications. Their product offerings include CVD systems, dry etching systems, and surface cleaning systems, catering to a variety of semiconductor device fabrication needs.
capabilities: CVD systems for thin film deposition
Dry etching systems for precise material removal
Surface cleaning systems for semiconductor substrates
Turnkey solutions for MEMS and photonics applications

regional_presence.Japan: Additional sales offices are located in Tokyo, Nagoya, and Tsukuba.
regional_presence.United States: Samco has a business center in Silicon Valley, focusing on the North American market.
regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has a sales office in Taiwan to support regional customers.
regional_presence.China: Samco maintains sales offices in Shanghai and Tsukuba to cater to the Chinese market.
regional_presence.Singapore: There is a sales office in Singapore to enhance its presence in Southeast Asia.
